task.title: To show or hide caption for a repeat table

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced for Conga CLM (Contracts for Salesforce) and open the template.
In the Templates pane, go to Work> F ields. This displays the Repeat Table (object name) and the fields in the repeat table.
Select the Repeat Table and click the Settings button() next to Repeat Table.
In the Table Attributes section, toggle the Show Caption switch on and click Save. By default, it is on.
